title: Prismatic glass / electric blue
positive: A three-dimensional art-glass sculpture of Ma Durga, a translucent icy-blue crystalline bust with a complete fan-shaped crown and a dignified serene face. Smooth continuous facial planes, clear sculpted eyes and a tiny rose-colored forehead eye, delicate glass nose ring, glass sari covering the shoulders; no arms in frame. Place the sculpture slightly RIGHT of center. The material refracts cyan, violet and rose light, with crisp luminous edges and a soft pearlescent core. A few enormous curved optical glass prisms float on the left, casting ribbons of spectral caustics across a dark cobalt background. High-end physically based CGI, optical laboratory meets contemporary sacred art, cool iridescent palette, no gold, airy negative space. A respectful contemporary artistic interpretation of Ma Durga, serene, beautiful and powerful. Two carefully matched natural almond eyes with aligned pupils, plus one small distinct vertical third eye centered on the forehead. Fully clothed. Panoramic 104:45 composition, a clear face readable on an LED wall, generous breathing room. No lettering.
